description: Jansen, Malte and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The deposit is the supplementary software-and-data package for the offshore-wind competitiveness study by Jansen and colleagues. Its native resource type is software, while the description explicitly identifies a combined dataset and analysis package. It is retained as one supporting data resource because the inspected description does not identify an independently reusable named model. Historical prose says it was under peer review, but current native metadata reports open access with an attached archive. No archive or README was opened, so internal variables, countries and execution requirements remain unspecified. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
